title: AI Agents & Software Engineering
businessQuestion: How does autonomous code generation and verification compress software engineering overhead?
investorQuestion: Do developer tools convert seat-based software licences into work-completed compute billings?
overview: Most of this sector is still at proof of concept: agents that plan, call tools and write code exist, but reliability, evaluation and permissioning remain unsolved. The companies here cluster around developer tooling rather than end-user products, so the near-term bet is on other software businesses adopting agents — not on consumer demand arriving on schedule.
